scope: Sixth bounded target-specific wave: 12 independently researched direct material matches with no inherited family credit.

methodology.credit_rule: Only target-specific official repositories pinned to immutable commits and exact source loci proving a material same-target slice receive credit.
methodology.licence_rule: Only repository-native MIT, Apache-2.0 and GPL-3.0 community source is credited; hosted services, paid products and private extensions are excluded.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layout.
methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, queue, deployment or Git state was changed.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: A signed-out user can open password recovery, submit the account email, cause the configured password broker to attempt delivery of a reset link, and receive an explicit result.

benchmark.proven_slice: Provides the recovery view, normalises the username, invokes the password broker with the email, and returns successful or failed reset-link responses.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion mail transport, anti-enumeration copy, throttling, branded email, delivery or browser acceptance.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned repository-native Fortify source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: A user possessing a reset token can submit the token, email and confirmed replacement password; the broker validates and persists the reset, completes authentication state and returns an explicit result.

benchmark.proven_slice: Renders reset, requires token, email and password, invokes the broker with confirmation, runs the reset action, completes reset state and distinguishes success from failure.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion password rules, token lifetime or storage, email ownership, session policy, UX or runtime persistence.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned repository-native Fortify source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: A signed-out user can open login, submit credentials through throttling and authentication controls, establish a session, and later log out with session invalidation and CSRF regeneration.

benchmark.proven_slice: Provides login view and pipeline, optional username normalisation, throttling, two-factor redirection, authentication, session preparation, logout, invalidation and CSRF regeneration.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion approval checks, role landing, remember-me behavior, cookie policy, lockout policy or browser results.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned repository-native Fortify source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authenticated user can re-enter the current password before a sensitive action; successful confirmation is timestamped and remains valid only for the configured timeout.

benchmark.proven_slice: Checks the password against the authenticated user, stores successful confirmation time, returns explicit success or failure, and evaluates freshness against a timeout.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove which Oblivion actions are protected, policy overrides, audit events, WebAuthn equivalence or deployed middleware wiring.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned repository-native Fortify source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authenticated user can change their own password only after supplying the current password and a valid confirmed replacement; the replacement is hashed and persisted and stale reset material is invalidated.

benchmark.proven_slice: Validates current password and replacement rules, hashes and saves the replacement, deletes a reset token, emits an update event and returns a typed response.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion strength rules, history, forced session revocation, audit presentation or runtime behavior.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned repository-native Fortify source and supplied stub only; downstream customisations excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised settings user can list API credentials, create a named credential with bounded permissions and one-time plaintext disclosure, change permissions, and revoke or delete it.

benchmark.proven_slice: Lists tokens and last use, creates a named token with validated abilities and one-time plaintext return, updates abilities and deletes a token; Sanctum stores a hash with abilities and optional expiry.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion organisation scope, key formatting, webhook credentials, revoked-state retention, audit events or runtime authorization.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned Jetstream and Sanctum repository-native source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authenticated user can update their own profile identity fields and manage a profile photo, with previous photo storage cleaned up when replaced or removed.

benchmark.proven_slice: Updates authenticated-user profile information and supports photo upload, replacement cleanup, deletion and resolved photo URL.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion phone, job title, landing preference, crop, email reverification, permissions or runtime storage.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned Fortify and Jetstream repository-native source only; downstream customisations excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authenticated user can delete their own account only after password confirmation, with owned authentication artifacts cleaned up and the active session logged out and invalidated.

benchmark.proven_slice: Confirms the password, invokes self-deletion, deletes profile photo and tokens, deletes the user, logs out, invalidates the session and regenerates CSRF.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion deletion retention, privacy approval, audit export, warnings or referential integrity.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned repository-native Jetstream source and supplied deletion stub only; downstream customisations excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised administrator can inspect sessions belonging to a selected user and invalidate that user's active sessions, with permission checks, client logout propagation and an administrative event.

benchmark.proven_slice: Requires user-view permission to list selected-user sessions and user-manage permission to mark credentials not-before, perform backchannel logout for every session and record an admin event.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion single-session termination, database-session schema, keep-current rule, audit payload, role matrix or runtime behavior.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned community Keycloak server source only; hosted identity services and proprietary providers excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised receivables user can select unreconciled customer payments and outstanding invoices, allocate an amount without exceeding either remaining balance, persist reconciliation and receive an explicit result.

benchmark.proven_slice: Loads outstanding invoices, allocates available payment amounts, calculates exchange differences, rejects over-allocation, reconciles documents and returns success.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion organisation/client scope, payment-source model, currency policy, permissions, idempotency, UI or ledger results.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned ERPNext community source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised receivables user can select a customer and reporting date or period, generate a statement from receivable or ledger activity, render it and produce downloadable or dispatchable output.

benchmark.proven_slice: Validates customers and format, builds customer-specific receivable or ledger filters, derives statement and ageing data, renders HTML/PDF, downloads and dispatches statements.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion fields, as-of semantics, branding, email authorization, privacy, balance accuracy or delivery.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned ERPNext community source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: An authorised finance user can create, inspect, update and disable a bank-account record with bank identity, account number, linked ledger or party ownership, default-state validation and statement-balance support.

benchmark.proven_slice: Defines bank identity, bank, ledger or party ownership, account number, IBAN, integration identifier, defaults and disabled state; validates linkage, lists active accounts and stores statement balances.
benchmark.parity_limits: Does not prove Oblivion NZ fields, opening balance, organisation authorization, reconciliation counts, deletion, UI or persistence.

licence.edition_boundary: Pinned ERPNext community source only; hosted services and private extensions excluded.
